name: 3: 42-day QP reached; retain earnings
description: Creates a 2-year apprenticeship (730-day planned duration, qualifying period = 42 days), approves it, then records a completion after 60 days in learning. Because 30 < 42, earnings for periods prior to the completion date should be removed.

steps.name: SLD Records Completion (2 months in learning — above 42-day qualifying period)
